method.method_draft: Describe the image: locate N and P near the left side and note the high-latitude graticule, with most of the mapped square lying outside the small polar cap. From the text, use '再过8h，N地太阳高度达当日最大' to set N’s present local solar time to 04:00. Use 'N地比P地先见到日落' to decide which way along the drawn graticule is east/west, so the rest of the figure relative to N is mainly on the earlier/pre-dawn side rather than around midday. Since the text says only the area inside the 70° latitude line has polar day, treat that limited polar cap as daylight but the larger non-polar portion as night at this local-time position. Compare areas on the diagram: the non-polar night portion is larger than the polar-day/lighted portion, so most of the region is in darkness.
